Commit uncommitted work first. If a GitHub PR is already open, this pushes new commits and does not rewrite the description. If only a Local PR is open, title and body update that Local PR and retry GitHub create when the project opts in. Refused on the main working copy and while a loop is running. Give each a stable, descriptive title: a live workspace in the project with the same title is returned instead of a duplicate, so repeating the call is safe. Model and flags follow Settings (this chat vs that mode's default); Simplify follows this chat. The new workspace runs on its own; this chat does not wait for it. Each call starts an agent run — one child per distinct task, not extras. Prefer a child for anything beyond a very simple change. By default the workspace is a subagent (child) of this one: it starts from this branch. When it finishes you get a report; call merge_child to land its commits here, or archive_child to close it without merging. Pass standalone=true for independent work that should ship on its own.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"title":{"type":"string","description":"Short workspace title. Default false: the workspace is a subagent of this one, branched off this branch; when it finishes you get a report and must call merge_child to land its work (or archive_child to close it). Scheduled runs and mode=loop default to standalone"}},"required":["title","prompt"]}},{"name":"merge_child","description":"Land a finished subagent's commits: merge its child workspace branch --no-ff into this worktree and archive it. Works on running, finished, and archived children.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"workspace_id":{"type":"string","description":"Id of the subagent child workspace (from create_workspace or its report)"}},"required":["workspace_id"]}},{"name":"archive_child","description":"Close a finished subagent without merging: archives its child workspace once you have what you need from its report (research, a review, a spike). Its worktree and branch are deleted, so any unmerged commits are gone; merge_child first if you want them. Refused while the child is still running.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"workspace_id":{"type":"string","description":"Id of the subagent child workspace (from create_workspace or its report)"}},"required":["workspace_id"]}},{"name":"message_child","description":"Send a message to a child workspace. A running child is steered mid-turn: returns once it has accepted the message (may take until its next tool call) and it continues. A finished (not merged or archived) child starts a new turn with the message and reports back again when it finishes. Works with any harness.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"workspace_id":{"type":"string","description":"Id of the child workspace (from create_workspace or its report)"},"message":{"type":"string","description":"Instruction for the child (steers a running turn, or starts a new turn on a finished child)"}},"required":["workspace_id","message"]}},{"name":"list_terminals","description":"List this workspace's live Observatory terminal tabs (id, title, cwd, whether it is the focused tab). Use when the user mentions the terminal, a build/test error on screen, or before read_terminal if you need an id.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{}}},{"name":"read_terminal","description":"Read recent output from an Observatory terminal (ANSI stripped). id is a session id from list_terminals (or omit to read the focused tab). tail_lines defaults to 200 (max 2000). Prefer this over guessing that output lives in a worktree file.","inputSchema":{"type":"object","properties":{"id":{"type":"string","description":"Session id from list_terminals; omit to read the focused tab"},"tail_lines":{"type":"integer","description":"Last N lines (default 200, max 2000)"}}}}]}}
